# LootTable

**Tags:** `loot`

Defines the rules that govern what items drop when a creature dies. Each entry specifies an item, a quantity range, and a drop chance. The LootTable is shared across all instances of a creature species; individual rolls are performed per kill by the loot system.

> **Goal:** Centralise drop rules in the design bible so balance changes are a single-source edit rather than scattered constants

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `state` | enum (`sealed`, `available`, `claimed`, `expired`) | yes |  |
| `creatureId` | string | yes | Entity key of the creature this table belongs to |
| `despawnSeconds` | integer | yes | Seconds before unclaimed loot is removed from the world |

### State machine

**Field:** `state` &nbsp; **Initial:** `sealed`

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> sealed
  sealed --> available : roll\n[Guaranteed entries (chance = 1.0) always produce their item; Chance entries are rolled independently; multiple chance drops can occur in one kill; Quantity is chosen uniformly at random within [minQty, maxQty]; Rolled items are placed at the creature's death position as world pickups; Emits a loot_dropped event with the full drop list]
  available --> claimed : collect\n[Collection transfers the item to the player's inventory via Inventory.pickup; When the last item is collected the state transitions to claimed]
  available --> expired : expire\n[Timer starts when state enters available; Expiry emits a loot_expired event so clients can hide the pickup indicator]
  claimed --> expired : expire\n[Timer starts when state enters available; Expiry emits a loot_expired event so clients can hide the pickup indicator]
  expired --> [*]
```

| State | Description | Terminal |
| ----- | ----------- | -------- |
| `sealed` | Loot has not yet been rolled; no items are visible |  |
| `available` | Loot roll has completed; items are present in the world and can be picked up |  |
| `claimed` | All items have been picked up; the container is empty |  |
| `expired` | Despawn timer elapsed with unclaimed items; items are removed from the world | yes |

## Behaviors

### `roll`

Perform the loot roll for all entries in the table and place results in the world

**Rules:**
- Guaranteed entries (chance = 1.0) always produce their item
- Chance entries are rolled independently; multiple chance drops can occur in one kill
- Quantity is chosen uniformly at random within [minQty, maxQty]
- Rolled items are placed at the creature's death position as world pickups
- Emits a loot_dropped event with the full drop list

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `collect`

A player picks up one or more items from the available loot

**Rules:**
- Collection transfers the item to the player's inventory via Inventory.pickup
- When the last item is collected the state transitions to claimed

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `expire`

Despawn timer elapses; all remaining items are removed

**Rules:**
- Timer starts when state enters available
- Expiry emits a loot_expired event so clients can hide the pickup indicator

**Auth:** `maintainer`
